releases.body:
This repo now ships the Tavily plugin for Cursor and Codex as well as Claude Code, with the same skills and hosted MCP server in all three.

## Changes

- **Cursor plugin.** `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` adds the skills, the hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp`, and a rule (`rules/tavily-awareness.mdc`) that reminds the agent to use `tavily_search` for recent information and docs and `tavily_extract` for URLs. It replaces the separate `tavily-cursor-plugin` repo (#42).
- **Codex plugin.** `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` adds the skills and the MCP server. Install it with `codex plugin marketplace add tavily-ai/skills`, then add Tavily from `/plugins` (#42).
- **Claude Code startup hook.** The Claude plugin now adds the same Tavily reminder to the context when a session starts, after `/clear`, and after compaction (#42).
- **Skills grouped on skills.sh** into Core, Tasks, and Developers (#41).
- **Plugin version set to 2.3.0** in every manifest. The previous Cursor plugin was at 2.2.0.
- **OpenAI plugin ZIP.** Each release now attaches `tavily-openai-plugin-<version>.zip`, the package for the OpenAI plugin directory. It isn't an install method; use the marketplace commands above.

The skills are unchanged from v2.1.0.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tavily-ai/skills/compare/v2.1.0...v2.3.0

The Claude plugin now installs Tavily's MCP server along with the skills.

## Changes

- **MCP server bundled in the Claude plugin.** A new root `.mcp.json` registers the hosted server at `https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp` with OAuth sign-in, so installing the plugin also gives Claude the `tavily_search`, `tavily_extract`, `tavily_map`, `tavily_crawl` and `tavily_research` tools (#40).
- **Plugin version set to 2.1.0** in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `marketplace.json`. Claude Code installs updates only when this number changes, so users already on 2.0.0 now get the bundled MCP server.
- **Privacy policy URL** added to the plugin manifest.

The skills are unchanged from v2.0.0.

If you already added Tavily with `claude mcp add`, you can remove that entry after updating the plugin, to avoid seeing each tool twice.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tavily-ai/skills/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0

First tagged release of Tavily agent skills. Skills are now grouped into core, task and developer skills.

## Skills

| Skill | Type | What it does |
|-------|------|--------------|
| `tavily-search` | Core | Search, extract, map and crawl as one toolkit |
| `tavily-research` | Task | In-depth research into a cited report |
| `tavily-entity` | Task | One company or person for a CRM, or CSV enrichment |
| `tavily-list` | Task | Deduplicated, capped table of matches |
| `tavily-monitor` | Task | A search or extraction run on a cadence, with a baseline |
| `tavily-sdk` | Developers | Reference for building Tavily integrations |

## Breaking changes

- `tavily-cli`, `tavily-extract`, `tavily-map`, `tavily-crawl` and `tavily-dynamic-search` are removed. Their content is now in `tavily-search` and its `references/`.
- `tavily-best-practices` is replaced by `tavily-sdk`.
- Skills moved under `skills/core/`, `skills/tasks/` and `skills/developers/`.

## Other changes

- Codex MCP setup added to the `tavily-search` setup reference (#38).
- Independent searches run as separate `tvly` calls in one turn.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add tavily-ai/skills
```
